name: Static
description: A presence in background electromagnetic radiation that manifests as subtle pattern anomalies in white noise. Detectable only through statistical analysis of ambient EM fields.
observed_behavior: Modulates ambient electromagnetic noise in ways that deviate from random by 0.003%. The deviation is consistent and spatially localized.
story_hooks: A physicist measuring EM noise discovers the pattern and spends three years trying to determine if it's communication. She never decides.
